confirmed_defects.violated_requirement: T002 and FR-002: contextual root diagnostics must reflect available source identity.

confirmed_defects.exact_correction: Use a case-specific expected workflow identity for the malformed root metadata case, consistent with the chosen root-error contract, retaining fixture only for definitions that actually contain that ID. Do not manufacture fixture in the controller.

confirmed_defects.violated_requirement: T002: focused validation must exercise every malformed container and every producer-reference case.
confirmed_defects.observed_deficiency: Both matrix tests close self.subTest before the diagnostic assertions. A caught first-case failure leaves diagnostic None and the assertion outside subTest aborts the whole test, so remaining malformed container and producer cases are never exercised. Independent run demonstrates only root-workflow-container-invalid and producer-unknown subtest outcomes before outer failures. There are also no assertions excluding raw input values, rendered prompts or host paths despite the explicit task requirement.
confirmed_defects.exact_correction: Keep each case validation and all diagnostic assertions inside its subTest; add explicit portable diagnostic exclusion checks using authored sentinel values so all required cases run independently and privacy expectations are tested.

confirmed_defects.violated_requirement: T004 and FR-001: source-definition validation must be exercised before release verification and install/refresh effects.
confirmed_defects.observed_deficiency: Verification/install negative changes workflow bytes but retains the original release digest, and expects workflow source differs.
